subject: Redwood x CloudNova — facilitator coverage & staggered co-sell demo
messages:
From: Emily Chang <emily@cloudnova.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner PM <aws-partners@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x CloudNova product showcase — marketplace & SI alignment

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the intro via the AWS partners team. CloudNova is moving rapidly on our marketplace listing and our systems integrator partners want a joined showcase that covers (1) Redwood's hosted marketplace listing behavior, (2) the Dedicated/Private options for regulated APAC customers, and (3) a short technical deep-dive for our SI engineers.

We need to land a 60–75 minute session that accommodates APAC attendees but doesn't leave NA customers out. Our presenters are available broadly the week of Oct 20, but with limited APAC-sized windows (our lead SI can only join mornings AEST). Can Redwood own facilitation (run-of-show + recording) and provide an ops facilitator for timezone handoffs?

Proposed windows (we can pick one or run two shorter regional sessions):
- Tue Oct 20 — 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC (Americas-friendly)
- Wed Oct 21 — 09:00 CET / 08:00 UTC (Euro/APAC overlap)

I attached a draft agenda and a short list of customer questions. Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood would cover ops + tech?

Thanks,
Emily Chang
Partnerships, CloudNova
attachments: cloudnova_redwood_agenda_v2.pdf, cloudnova_customer_questions.xlsx

From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chang <emily@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudNova product showcase — marketplace & SI alignment

Emily — thanks, this looks great. Happy to own facilitation.

Quick thoughts / proposal:
- Recommend two staggered sessions instead of one monster call: a 60-minute Americas session (Tue Oct 20 09:00 PT) and a 45–60 minute APAC-focused session (Wed Oct 21 01:00 AEST) to respect presenter availability. We can record / stitch for on-demand.
- Vanessa will be primary ops facilitator (run-of-show, recording, Q&A triage). Karthik will cover the technical deep-dive and SI handoff.
- I added a lightweight run-of-show and a shortened APAC agenda (attached).

If you prefer a single session, we can also do Tue Oct 20 09:00 PT and organize two facilitators to manage region-by-region handoffs — that will be longer (~75 minutes).

Action items:
1) Confirm whether you want two sessions or one merged session.
2) Confirm presenter availability for the APAC morning (we proposed Wed Oct 21 01:00 AEST as a possible slot).
3) If two sessions, I'll send calendar invites and a HubSpot meeting record (CLDN-8342).

Calendars: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdefg12345
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/CloudNova

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_run_of_show_v1.pdf

Thanks Avery — two sessions sounds sensible. Our SI lead can do the APAC morning but only for a 45-minute window (they need to hop to client work). We can do the Americas session on Tue Oct 20 09:00 PT, and the APAC session on Wed Oct 21 07:30 AEST (45 minutes).

Prefer Redwood handle the recording and the first 20 minutes of the APAC session (context + marketplace mechanics) then pass to CloudNova/SI for the technical use-cases. Also: can you surface the latest quantized inference profile and latency expectations in the tech deep-dive? Our SI will triage those questions.

Confirmed slots:
- Americas: Tue Oct 20, 09:00 PT (60 min) — intended for NA buyers and AWS channel reps
- APAC: Wed Oct 21, 07:30 AEST (45 min) — intended for APAC prospects, SI engineers

I'll send calendar holds from CloudNova once you confirm invites.

Emily

All — confirmed on our side. I'll own ops for both sessions and will publish a run-of-show with explicit handoff cues.

Draft run-of-show highlights (APAC 45-min):
- 00:00–05:00 — Welcome + why marketplace listing matters (Avery)
- 05:00–20:00 — Redwood marketplace mechanics + latency/cost profile (Karthik)
- 20:00–35:00 — CloudNova SI use cases + joint architecture (CloudNova lead)

I'll add break-out instructions for APAC engineers who might need a follow-up tech session. Calendar invites to be sent by EOD for the confirmed slots. Recording settings: on, auto-transcript on, retention 90 days per CloudNova request.

Karthik — please attach the latency/quantization slide you plan to present so I can include it in the run-of-show.

Vanessa Ortiz
